svg.aria-label: Proposition 40 passage odds on Kalshi and Polymarket from October 2025 to October 2026, and a scatter of daily changes in the odds against daily changes in the California-minus-national municipal bond fund spread, with fitted slopes near zero and a dashed reference line for an effect near the detection floor
svg.text: Proposition 40: Passage odds and the California fund spread
Trading days from Oct 29, 2025 to Oct 9, 2026 (Kalshi from Jan 2, 2026). Spread: the iShares California fund (CMF)
against the national fund (MUB), in basis points of yield.
Chance of passage at the 4 p.m. Eastern close
Each trading day: change in the odds against change in the spread
A tilted line would mean the spread moved with the odds. The dashed line shows an effect near the detection floor.
Change in the chance of passage from the previous close, percentage points
A 6 bp effect per full swing
Sources: Kalshi and Polymarket APIs; daily fund prices from Yahoo Finance. Spread change = the MUB-minus-CMF daily return
difference divided by CMF's 7.08-year effective duration. Positive means California's yields rose against the nation's.
The test catches an effect of 5 to 7 bp per full swing four times in five, depending on the market and the direction.
